turns.user_utterance: Can you tell my why my card payment has been reverted.
turns.assistant_response: Yes—card payments get reverted when the merchant’s authorization is canceled or reversed, or when a verification/settlement issue occurs (for example, insufficient funds/limits at the time, or the merchant didn’t complete the transaction). Can you share the date and the amount of the reverted payment (and whether it says “reverted” or “reversed” in the app) so I can check the most likely reason for your case?
